member.notes: Method: real member JWT minted for test user Ivan Horvat (09da831d-6f52-4068-806d-aa4be6920830, ivan.horvat@test.medx.hr) against user-portal JWT_SECRET; Playwright chromium at 390x844; per-page probe for scrollWidth/overflow/tap-targets/font-size/broken-images. 26 evidence files in /tmp/5z/member/. CLEAN results worth knowing: no horizontal document overflow on any page (scrollWidth <= 390 everywhere); zero broken images (the Building Bridges 'Moments' mosaic that looks blank in full-page shots is just loading=lazy — loads fine on scroll); Gala page is the cleanest surface; Plexus register flow works end-to-end to the payment gate (pass select -> package builder -> Your Info prefilled -> Order Summary Student Early Bird EUR 39 correct; stopped before 'Proceed to Payment' per frozen-surface rule); FAQ assistant FAB opens a clean full-screen sheet and answered a test question correctly; forum wing correctly recognizes the member session ('signed in, but not yet within the circle'). Structural caveats: (1) the notification panel's -8px x-offset when open is a desktop-scrollbar artifact (panel width 100vw vs clientWidth) and will not reproduce on real phones — do NOT ship a fix for that; the transparent background is real regardless. (2) CME view could not be audited visually: #pxCmeSection ('Continuing Medical Education', OIB/DOB consent) exists in the Plexus registration form but is display:none because the dev Plexus event is not flagged HLK-accredited — needs a flagged event to test. (3) fullPage screenshots show the fixed bottom nav mid-image; that is a screenshot artifact, cross-checked all overlap findings in live viewport. (4) The two account-menu/profile findings compound: the ONLY visibly working account action on mobile is Sign out. DB hygiene: my single test write (assistant_faq_log row from the FAQ question) was deleted and deletion verified (table back to 0 rows); no other rows created (register flow never POSTed, notifications are group-based with no per-user rows for the test user).

findings.where: Global QR scanner FAB #globalQRBtn (z-index 900, rect x328-374 y780-826) vs iOS install banner #medxStaffInstall (z-index 99999, fixed bottom:12px, ~80px tall) — banner script at index.html:47213-47250
findings.what: On iOS UA the 'Install the Staff app' banner auto-shows 4s after every load until dismissed and completely covers the global scanner FAB — the primary event-day control — plus the bottom of the staff-share consent sheet, the open nav drawer, and the scanner modal's search-results area (all screenshots show it). Dismissal persists in localStorage, but every fresh device/private session (exactly the borrowed-phone-at-the-door scenario) hits it first. Suggest capping z-index below FABs or auto-hiding when a scanner/panel is open.

findings.where: Auction paddle-entry modal #auctionModal (AuctionAdmin.modal/openStaffBid, index.html:~33560-33580)
findings.what: No Escape-close handler (global QR scanner modal has one at 24783) — only Cancel and backdrop-click close it. It also stays mounted across SPA section switches: after hash/section navigation the modal remained overlaid on Live Ops Map, CME, and Print Suite (screenshots 07/08/09/11 of first run). Otherwise the modal itself renders excellently at 390px (inputs 40px tall, clear Cancel/Add bid).

findings.where: Event-day text inputs: #pxCheckinInput (14px), paddle modal #acSbName/#acSbPaddle/#acSbAmount (14px), global scanner manual-entry input, email-blast filters #blastFilterTicket/#blastFilterCountry (13px)
findings.what: Font-size below 16px triggers iOS Safari's focus auto-zoom (viewport meta has no maximum-scale), so the screen jumps/zooms every time staff tap the check-in or paddle field mid-rush. Bumping these inputs to 16px kills the zoom without harming layout.

findings.where: FAB stack bottom-right: #staffShareBtn (y668-714), #assistantFab (y724-770), #globalQRBtn (y780-826), all 46px at x328-374, z 900
findings.what: Three stacked FABs consume ~160px of the right edge; at common scroll positions they cover right-aligned controls — the teal share FAB directly overlaps the red 'Check In' button in Plexus Quick Check-in (13b-plexus-checkin-camera.png), and the lower FAB half-hides behind the install banner. Consider collapsing to a single expandable FAB on <768px.

findings.what: Tap target measures 107x18px (well under the 44px minimum). Adjacent 'Open / Mark done / Dismiss' are fine; only the ghost assign button is thumb-hostile. Evidence: 01-dashboard.png.

admin.notes: Method: real admin JWT (minted with backend JWT_SECRET for juginovic.alen@gmail.com, validated via /api/auth/me), Playwright chromium 390x844 iPhone UA + fake camera device, both portals healthy on 3001/3002. 38 artifacts in /tmp/5z/admin/ (screenshots + report.json + fixup-report.json). Structural observations: (1) No document-level horizontal overflow anywhere — all 24 audited states report overflowX=0; the 768px media block (index.html:3861-3968) already converts .data-table to display:block/overflow-x:auto with fixed thead/tbody layout, and .plexus-tabs wrap — wide tables scroll correctly on gala/plexus. (2) The event-day core is genuinely strong on mobile: global Quick Check-in modal (offline-cache count, per-event progress, camera+search+manual entry, Escape closes), auction admin, paddle modal, Live Ops Map settings, staff-share bottom sheet, CME/HLK, outbox approval cards, content studio, and the print suite (full-screen single-column sheet, live 8-up badge preview) all render cleanly at 390px. (3) Print suite showed 'Print engine ready' — CHROME_PATH resolves on this Mac so the 503 gate wasn't exercised; the 'Print engine off' warn chip state exists (index.html:44017) and the server returns a clean print_engine_unavailable 503 (server.js:25196). (4) Live Ops Map tiles come from a/b/c.tile.openstreetmap.org — loads failed here only because the sandbox blocks external network (net::ERR_FAILED, also fonts.gstatic.com), not a portal bug, but it is an external runtime dependency worth verifying on venue Wi-Fi. (5) Mobile nav rail is a 260px slide-in drawer with overlay; item heights 41-64px (all pass), inner #sidebarNav scrolls; note the drawer only lists sections enabled in the per-user 'Manage sections' preference — this admin account currently exposes Communications+2 Organization items, so Gala/Auctions/Live Ops/CME were reached programmatically; on a phone they'd need the command palette or section prefs (config, not a defect). (6) Sidebar uses height:100vh on mobile — consider 100dvh for iOS URL-bar chrome. (7) Frozen surfaces untouched; zero code changes. Test data: one ZZZ-MobileAudit-Test auction+item created to exercise paddle entry, deleted via API afterwards and verified (GET /api/admin/auctions returns 0 auctions); no check-ins, bids, or sends were performed.
